blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Army’s 6th Infantry Division (6ID) facilitated on Saturday, Oct. 24, the surrender of a soldier suspected of killing two village officials in Kabacan, Cotabato, on Oct. 21, the military said. Brig. Gen. Edgar Catu, the newly installed 6ID commander, identified the suspect as Cpl. Virgilio D. Magbiray Jr., who is assigned to the Army’s 90th Infantry Battalion. Police identified Magbiray as the primary suspect in the killing of brothers Patacpan Maganaka, village councilor, and Ibrahim Maganaka, village bookkeeper in Barangay Lower Paatan, Kabacan. Maj.
